```{r}
# 1. GRANULOMETRY (5 variables)
# 2. EXCHANGEABLE NUTRIENTS (4 variables - Ca, Mg, K, Na)
# 3. OTHER SOIL PROPERTIES (7 variables)
# 4. ILR COORDINATES (4 variables)

# Group 1: Granulometry (5)
GRANULO_VARS <- c(
  "Clay_percent",
  "Fine_Silt_percent",
  "Coarse_Silt_percent",
  "Fine_Sand_percent",
  "Coarse_Sand_percent"
)

GRANULO_LABELS <- c(
  "Clay (%)",
  "Fine Silt (%)",
  "Coarse Silt (%)",
  "Fine Sand (%)",
  "Coarse Sand (%)"
)

# Group 2: Exchangeable Nutrients (4 - including Na from enhanced)
EXCHANGEABLE_VARS <- c(
  "Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g",
  "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g", 
  "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g",
  "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g"  # From enhanced dataset
)

EXCHANGEABLE_LABELS <- c(
  "Exch. Ca (meq/100g)",
  "Exch. Mg (meq/100g)",
  "Exch. K (meq/100g)",
  "Exch. Na (meq/100g)"
)

EXCHANGEABLE_SOURCES <- c(
  "original",
  "original",
  "original",
  "enhanced"
)

# Group 3: Other Soil Properties (7)
OTHER_VARS <- c(
  "pH",
  "Organic_Carbon_per_mille",
  "Total_Nitrogen_per_mille",
  "Available_P2O5_mg_kg",  # From enhanced dataset
  "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm",  # From enhanced dataset
  "Mg_Ca_Ratio",
  "Mg_K_Ratio",
  "Compaction_Index"  # From enhanced dataset
)

OTHER_LABELS <- c(
  "pH",
  "Organic C (‰)",
  "Total N (‰)",
  "Avail. P₂O₅ (mg/kg)",
  "EC (mmho/cm)",
  "Mg/Ca Ratio",
  "Mg/K Ratio",
  "Compaction Index"
)

OTHER_SOURCES <- c(
  "original",
  "original",
  "original",
  "enhanced",
  "enhanced",
  "original",
  "original",
  "enhanced"
)

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: JOURNAL-STYLE PLOTTING FUNCTION FOR ORIGINAL VARS
# ============================================================================

create_journal_plot_object <- function(var_name, var_label, data_sf, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("📊", var_name, "\n")
  }
  
  # Column names
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Check columns exist
  if (!pred_col %in% colnames(data_sf) || !pred_type_col %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
    if (verbose) {
      cat("  ⚠️ Skipping - columns not found\n")
    }
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extract and prepare data
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[var_name]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Training",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        ),
        levels = c("Training", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ No valid data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Calculate metrics by dataset
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Insufficient data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_data$Observed - train_data$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_data$Observed - val_data$Predicted)^2))
  
  # Determine axis limits
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Create plot (same style as original but MORE COMPACT)
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    # 1:1 reference line
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
    
    # Smooth regression lines (thinner)
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 0.7) +
    
    # Data points (smaller)
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0.2) +
    
    # Color scheme
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Training" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    
    # Equal aspect ratio
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    
    # Labels (more compact)
    labs(
      x = "Observed",
      y = "Predicted",
      title = var_label
    ) +
    
    # Metrics annotation (smaller and more compact)
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.08, 0.15, 0.22) * val_span,
      label = c(
        sprintf("Train: R²=%.2f", train_r2),
        sprintf("Valid: R²=%.2f", val_r2),
        sprintf("RMSE: %.2f/%.2f", train_rmse, val_rmse)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 2.2,  # Smaller text
      color = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "black"),
      fontface = c("bold", "bold", "plain")
    ) +
    
    # Theme (more compact)
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +  # Smaller base size
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 2)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 0.6),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)  # Tighter margins
    )
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✓ Train: R²=", round(train_r2, 3), ", Valid: R²=", round(val_r2, 3), "\n")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: JOURNAL-STYLE PLOTTING FUNCTION FOR ENHANCED VARS
# ============================================================================

create_journal_plot_object_enhanced <- function(var_name, var_label, data_sf, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("📊", var_name, "(enhanced)\n")
  }
  
  # Column names
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Find original variable column
  possible_original_names <- c(
    var_name,
    gsub("_", "", var_name),
    paste0(var_name, "_original")
  )
  
  original_col <- NULL
  for (name in possible_original_names) {
    if (name %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
      original_col <- name
      break
    }
  }
  
  if (is.null(original_col)) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Original variable column not found\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Check required columns exist
  required_cols <- c(original_col, pred_col, pred_type_col)
  missing_cols <- required_cols[!required_cols %in% colnames(data_sf)]
  
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Missing columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extract and prepare data
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[original_col]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[original_col]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Training",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        ),
        levels = c("Training", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ No valid data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Calculate metrics by dataset
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Insufficient data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_data$Observed - train_data$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_data$Observed - val_data$Predicted)^2))
  
  # Determine axis limits
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Create plot (more compact)
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0.2) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Training" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs(
      x = "Observed",
      y = "Predicted",
      title = var_label
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.08, 0.15, 0.22) * val_span,
      label = c(
        sprintf("Train: R²=%.2f", train_r2),
        sprintf("Valid: R²=%.2f", val_r2),
        sprintf("RMSE: %.2f/%.2f", train_rmse, val_rmse)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 2.2,
      color = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "black"),
      fontface = c("bold", "bold", "plain")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 2)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 0.6),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✓ Train: R²=", round(train_r2, 3), ", Valid: R²=", round(val_r2, 3), "\n")
  }
  
  return(p)
}


cat("\n🔄 CREATING PLOT OBJECTS IN ORGANIZED ORDER:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

plot_list <- list()
plot_counter <- 0

# ============================================================================
# GROUP 1: GRANULOMETRY (5 plots)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n[GROUP 1: GRANULOMETRY - 5 VARIABLES]\n")
cat("-", rep("-", 48), "\n", sep="")
for (i in seq_along(GRANULO_VARS)) {
  var_name <- GRANULO_VARS[i]
  var_label <- GRANULO_LABELS[i]
  plot_counter <- plot_counter + 1
  cat(sprintf("[%2d] ", plot_counter))
  
  p <- create_journal_plot_object(var_name, var_label, parcelles_all, verbose = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    plot_list[[var_name]] <- p
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# GROUP 2: EXCHANGEABLE NUTRIENTS (4 plots)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n[GROUP 2: EXCHANGEABLE NUTRIENTS - 4 VARIABLES]\n")
cat("-", rep("-", 48), "\n", sep="")
for (i in seq_along(EXCHANGEABLE_VARS)) {
  var_name <- EXCHANGEABLE_VARS[i]
  var_label <- EXCHANGEABLE_LABELS[i]
  source_type <- EXCHANGEABLE_SOURCES[i]
  plot_counter <- plot_counter + 1
  cat(sprintf("[%2d] ", plot_counter))
  
  if (source_type == "original") {
    p <- create_journal_plot_object(var_name, var_label, parcelles_all, verbose = TRUE)
  } else {
    p <- create_journal_plot_object_enhanced(var_name, var_label, parcelles_enhanced, verbose = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    plot_list[[var_name]] <- p
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# GROUP 3: OTHER SOIL PROPERTIES (8 plots)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n[GROUP 3: OTHER SOIL PROPERTIES - 8 VARIABLES]\n")
cat("-", rep("-", 48), "\n", sep="")
for (i in seq_along(OTHER_VARS)) {
  var_name <- OTHER_VARS[i]
  var_label <- OTHER_LABELS[i]
  source_type <- OTHER_SOURCES[i]
  plot_counter <- plot_counter + 1
  cat(sprintf("[%2d] ", plot_counter))
  
  if (source_type == "original") {
    p <- create_journal_plot_object(var_name, var_label, parcelles_all, verbose = TRUE)
  } else {
    p <- create_journal_plot_object_enhanced(var_name, var_label, parcelles_enhanced, verbose = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    plot_list[[var_name]] <- p
  }
}

cat("\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")
cat("✅ Total plots created:", length(plot_list), "\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 9: FORCE 4-COLUMN GRID LAYOUT
# ============================================================================
n_plots <- length(plot_list)
cat("\n📐 SETTING GRID LAYOUT:\n")
cat("  Total plots:", n_plots, "\n")

# Force 4 columns
n_cols <- 5
n_rows <- ceiling(n_plots / n_cols)

cat("  Grid dimensions:", n_rows, "×", n_cols, "(forced 4 columns)\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 10: COMBINE PLOTS INTO GRID
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🎨 COMBINING PLOTS INTO GRID:\n")

# Use patchwork to combine plots
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = n_cols, nrow = n_rows)

# Add a common title and caption
combined_plot <- combined_plot +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Model Performance: Observed vs Predicted Values",
    subtitle = "Organized by groups: Granulometry (5) | Exchangeable (4) | Other Properties (8)",
    caption = "Training (blue) and Validation (orange). Dashed red line = 1:1 reference. Shaded bands = 95% CI.",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey50")
    )
  )

# ============================================================================
# STEP 11: SAVE COMBINED GRID (COMPACT VERSION)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n💾 SAVING COMBINED GRID:\n")

# Calculate figure dimensions (MORE COMPACT - smaller subplots)
subplot_width_mm <- 50   # Reduced from 60
subplot_height_mm <- 50  # Reduced from 60
margin_mm <- 15          # Reduced from 20

total_width_mm <- n_cols * subplot_width_mm + margin_mm
total_height_mm <- n_rows * subplot_height_mm + margin_mm + 25  # +25 for title/subtitle

cat("  Figure dimensions:", total_width_mm, "×", total_height_mm, "mm\n")
cat("  (Compact version: 4 columns, smaller subplots)\n")

# Save PNG
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "combined_grid_all_variables_ENHANCED.png"),
  combined_plot,
  width = total_width_mm,
  height = total_height_mm,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

# Save PDF
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "combined_grid_all_variables_ENHANCED.pdf"),
  combined_plot,
  width = total_width_mm,
  height = total_height_mm,
  units = "mm",
  device = cairo_pdf,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
create_journal_plot_object_fr <- function(var_name, var_label, data_sf, letter_label = NULL, 
                                          save_individual = TRUE, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      cat("📊 ", letter_label, ". ", var_name, "\n", sep = "")
    } else {
      cat("📊", var_name, "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Noms des colonnes
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Vérifier que les colonnes existent
  if (!pred_col %in% colnames(data_sf) || !pred_type_col %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
    if (verbose) {
      cat("  ⚠️ Ignoré - colonnes introuvables\n")
    }
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extraire et préparer les données
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[var_name]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Entraînement",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Autre"
        ),
        levels = c("Entraînement", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Pas de données valides\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Calculer les métriques
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Entraînement")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Données insuffisantes\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_data$Observed - train_data$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_data$Observed - val_data$Predicted)^2))
  
  # Limites des axes
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Créer labs() avec ou sans tag - FORMAT "a." au lieu de "(a)"
  if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = "Observé",
      y = "Prédit",
      title = var_label,
      tag = paste0(letter_label, ".")
    )
  } else {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = "Observé",
      y = "Prédit",
      title = var_label
    )
  }
  
  # Créer le graphique - BORDURES PLUS ÉPAISSES
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.0) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs_list +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.08, 0.15, 0.22) * val_span,
      label = c(
        sprintf("Entr.: R²=%.2f", train_r2),
        sprintf("Valid.: R²=%.2f", val_r2),
        sprintf("RMSE: %.2f/%.2f", train_rmse, val_rmse)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.5,
      color = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "black"),
      fontface = c("bold", "bold", "plain")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 3)),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, color = "grey20"),  # COULEUR GREY-BLACK
      plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.99),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 1.8),  # BORDURE PLUS ÉPAISSE: 0.8 -> 1.8
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
    )
  
  # Sauvegarder individuellement
  if (save_individual) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_fr_large.png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_fr_large.pdf")
    } else {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_fr_large.png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_fr_large.pdf")
    }
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_png),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      dpi = 600,
      bg = "white"
    )
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_pdf),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      device = cairo_pdf,
      bg = "white"
    )
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✓ Entr.: R²=", round(train_r2, 3), ", Valid.: R²=", round(val_r2, 3), "\n")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# ============================================================================
# ÉTAPE 5: FONCTION DE GRAPHIQUE POUR VARIABLES AMÉLIORÉES AVEC LETTRE
# POLICES BEAUCOUP PLUS GRANDES + BORDURES PLUS ÉPAISSES
# ============================================================================

create_journal_plot_object_enhanced_fr <- function(var_name, var_label, data_sf, letter_label = NULL,
                                                     save_individual = TRUE, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      cat("📊 ", letter_label, ". ", var_name, " (amélioré)\n", sep = "")
    } else {
      cat("📊", var_name, "(amélioré)\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Noms des colonnes
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Trouver la colonne originale
  possible_original_names <- c(
    var_name,
    gsub("_", "", var_name),
    paste0(var_name, "_original")
  )
  
  original_col <- NULL
  for (name in possible_original_names) {
    if (name %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
      original_col <- name
      break
    }
  }
  
  if (is.null(original_col)) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Colonne originale introuvable\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Vérifier colonnes
  required_cols <- c(original_col, pred_col, pred_type_col)
  missing_cols <- required_cols[!required_cols %in% colnames(data_sf)]
  
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Colonnes manquantes:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Préparer les données
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[original_col]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[original_col]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Entraînement",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Autre"
        ),
        levels = c("Entraînement", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Pas de données valides\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Métriques
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Entraînement")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Données insuffisantes\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_data$Observed - train_data$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_data$Observed - val_data$Predicted)^2))
  
  # Limites axes
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Créer labs() avec ou sans tag - FORMAT "a." au lieu de "(a)"
  if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = "Observé",
      y = "Prédit",
      title = var_label,
      tag = paste0(letter_label, ".")
    )
  } else {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = "Observé",
      y = "Prédit",
      title = var_label
    )
  }
  
  # Graphique - BORDURES PLUS ÉPAISSES
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.0) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs_list +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.08, 0.15, 0.22) * val_span,
      label = c(
        sprintf("Entr.: R²=%.2f", train_r2),
        sprintf("Valid.: R²=%.2f", val_r2),
        sprintf("RMSE: %.2f/%.2f", train_rmse, val_rmse)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.5,
      color = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "black"),
      fontface = c("bold", "bold", "plain")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 3)),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, color = "grey20"),  # COULEUR GREY-BLACK
      plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.99),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 1.8),  # BORDURE PLUS ÉPAISSE: 0.8 -> 1.8
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
    )
  
  # Sauvegarder individuellement
  if (save_individual) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_enhanced_fr_large.png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_enhanced_fr_large.pdf")
    } else {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_enhanced_fr_large.png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_enhanced_fr_large.pdf")
    }
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_png),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      dpi = 600,
      bg = "white"
    )
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_pdf),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      device = cairo_pdf,
      bg = "white"
    )
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✓ Entr.: R²=", round(train_r2, 3), ", Valid.: R²=", round(val_r2, 3), "\n")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# ============================================================================
# ÉTAPE 6: CRÉER TOUS LES GRAPHIQUES AVEC LETTRES SÉQUENTIELLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 CRÉATION DES OBJETS GRAPHIQUES AVEC LETTRES:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

plot_list <- list()
plot_counter <- 0
letters_lower <- letters  # a, b, c, d, ...

# ============================================================================
# GROUPE 1: GRANULOMÉTRIE (5 graphiques)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n[GROUPE 1: GRANULOMÉTRIE - 5 VARIABLES]\n")
cat("-", rep("-", 48), "\n", sep="")
for (i in seq_along(GRANULO_VARS)) {
  var_name <- GRANULO_VARS[i]
  var_label <- GRANULO_LABELS_FR[i]
  plot_counter <- plot_counter + 1
  letter <- letters_lower[plot_counter]
  cat(sprintf("[%2d] ", plot_counter))
  
  p <- create_journal_plot_object_fr(var_name, var_label, parcelles_all, 
                                      letter_label = letter,
                                      save_individual = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    plot_list[[var_name]] <- p
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# GROUPE 2: ÉLÉMENTS ÉCHANGEABLES (4 graphiques)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n[GROUPE 2: ÉLÉMENTS ÉCHANGEABLES - 4 VARIABLES]\n")
cat("-", rep("-", 48), "\n", sep="")
for (i in seq_along(EXCHANGEABLE_VARS)) {
  var_name <- EXCHANGEABLE_VARS[i]
  var_label <- EXCHANGEABLE_LABELS_FR[i]
  source_type <- EXCHANGEABLE_SOURCES[i]
  plot_counter <- plot_counter + 1
  letter <- letters_lower[plot_counter]
  cat(sprintf("[%2d] ", plot_counter))
  
  if (source_type == "original") {
    p <- create_journal_plot_object_fr(var_name, var_label, parcelles_all,
                                        letter_label = letter,
                                        save_individual = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
  } else {
    p <- create_journal_plot_object_enhanced_fr(var_name, var_label, parcelles_enhanced,
                                                 letter_label = letter,
                                                 save_individual = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    plot_list[[var_name]] <- p
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# GROUPE 3: AUTRES PROPRIÉTÉS DU SOL (8 graphiques)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n[GROUPE 3: AUTRES PROPRIÉTÉS DU SOL - 8 VARIABLES]\n")
cat("-", rep("-", 48), "\n", sep="")
for (i in seq_along(OTHER_VARS)) {
  var_name <- OTHER_VARS[i]
  var_label <- OTHER_LABELS_FR[i]
  source_type <- OTHER_SOURCES[i]
  plot_counter <- plot_counter + 1
  letter <- letters_lower[plot_counter]
  cat(sprintf("[%2d] ", plot_counter))
  
  if (source_type == "original") {
    p <- create_journal_plot_object_fr(var_name, var_label, parcelles_all,
                                        letter_label = letter,
                                        save_individual = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
  } else {
    p <- create_journal_plot_object_enhanced_fr(var_name, var_label, parcelles_enhanced,
                                                 letter_label = letter,
                                                 save_individual = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    plot_list[[var_name]] <- p
  }
}

cat("\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")
cat("✅ Total de graphiques créés:", length(plot_list), "\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

# ============================================================================
# ÉTAPE 7: DÉFINIR LA DISPOSITION EN GRILLE (4 COLONNES)
# ============================================================================
n_plots <- length(plot_list)
cat("\n📐 DÉFINITION DE LA DISPOSITION EN GRILLE:\n")
cat("  Total de graphiques:", n_plots, "\n")

n_cols <- 5
n_rows <- ceiling(n_plots / n_cols)

cat("  Dimensions de la grille:", n_rows, "×", n_cols, "(4 colonnes)\n")

# ============================================================================
# ÉTAPE 8: COMBINER LES GRAPHIQUES EN GRILLE AVEC ESPACEMENT AUGMENTÉ
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🎨 COMBINAISON DES GRAPHIQUES EN GRILLE:\n")

combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = n_cols, nrow = n_rows) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Performance du modèle : Valeurs observées vs prédites",
    subtitle = "Organisé par groupes : Granulométrie (a-e) | Éléments échangeables (f-i) | Autres propriétés (j-q)",
    caption = "Entraînement (bleu) et Validation (orange). Ligne rouge pointillée = référence 1:1. Bandes ombrées = IC 95%.",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey50")
    )
  ) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(3, 8, 3, 3))  # ESPACEMENT HORIZONTAL AUGMENTÉ: right margin 3 -> 8

# ============================================================================
# ÉTAPE 9: SAUVEGARDER LA GRILLE COMBINÉE AVEC LARGEUR AUGMENTÉE
# ============================================================================
cat("\n💾 SAUVEGARDE DE LA GRILLE COMBINÉE:\n")

# Dimensions ajustées pour l'espacement horizontal augmenté
subplot_width_mm <- 70   # Augmenté de 65 à 70mm pour l'espacement
subplot_height_mm <- 65
margin_mm <- 10

total_width_mm <- n_cols * subplot_width_mm + margin_mm
total_height_mm <- n_rows * subplot_height_mm + margin_mm + 30

cat("  Dimensions:", total_width_mm, "×", total_height_mm, "mm\n")

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir_combined, "grille_combinee_4cols_improved_FR.png"),
  combined_plot,
  width = total_width_mm,
  height = total_height_mm,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir_combined, "grille_combinee_4cols_improved_FR.pdf"),
  combined_plot,
  width = total_width_mm,
  height = total_height_mm,
  units = "mm",
  device = cairo_pdf,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
create_journal_combined_plot_fr <- function(var_name, var_label_fr, data_sf, 
                                             is_enhanced = FALSE, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("📊", var_name, "\n")
  }
  
  # Noms des colonnes
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Pour les variables améliorées, trouver la colonne originale
  if (is_enhanced) {
    possible_original_names <- c(
      var_name,
      gsub("_", "", var_name),
      paste0(var_name, "_original")
    )
    
    original_col <- NULL
    for (name in possible_original_names) {
      if (name %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
        original_col <- name
        break
      }
    }
    
    if (is.null(original_col)) {
      if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Colonne originale introuvable\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  } else {
    original_col <- var_name
  }
  
  # Vérifier que les colonnes existent
  if (!pred_col %in% colnames(data_sf) || !pred_type_col %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
    if (verbose) {
      cat("  ⚠️ Ignoré - colonnes introuvables\n")
    }
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extraire et préparer les données
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[original_col]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[original_col]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Entraînement",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Autre"
        ),
        levels = c("Entraînement", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Pas de données valides\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Calculer les métriques par ensemble de données
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Entraînement")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Données insuffisantes\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  train_corr <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)
  val_corr <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)
  
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_data$Observed - train_data$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_data$Observed - val_data$Predicted)^2))
  
  # Déterminer les limites des axes
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Déterminer le suffixe des unités
  if (grepl("percent|Argile|Limon|Sable", var_label_fr, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    axis_label_suffix <- " (%)"
  } else if (grepl("meq|éch\\.", var_label_fr, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    axis_label_suffix <- " (meq/100g)"
  } else if (grepl("organique|total", var_label_fr, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    axis_label_suffix <- " (‰)"
  } else if (grepl("P₂O₅", var_label_fr, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    axis_label_suffix <- " (mg/kg)"
  } else if (grepl("CE", var_label_fr, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    axis_label_suffix <- " (mmho/cm)"
  } else {
    axis_label_suffix <- ""
  }
  
  # Créer le graphique (style exact de l'original)
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    # Ligne de référence 1:1 (proéminente)
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    
    # Lignes de régression lissées avec bandes de confiance
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
    
    # Points de données au-dessus
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 3, alpha = 0.75, stroke = 0.3) +
    
    # Schéma de couleurs et de remplissage
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    
    # Schéma de formes
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    
    # Limites des axes (rapport d'aspect égal)
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    
    # Étiquettes avec GRANDES polices
    labs(
      x = paste0("Observé ", var_label_fr, axis_label_suffix),
      y = paste0("Prédit ", var_label_fr, axis_label_suffix),
      title = var_label_fr
    ) +
    
    # Annotation personnalisée pour les métriques (texte plus grand)
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.08, 0.15, 0.22, 0.29, 0.36, 0.43) * val_span,
      label = c(
        "Entraînement:",
        sprintf("n = %d", nrow(train_data)),
        sprintf("R² = %.3f", train_r2),
        sprintf("r = %.3f", train_corr),
        sprintf("RMSE = %.3f", train_rmse),
        ""
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 5.5,
      color = "#0072B2",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain")
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.50, 0.57, 0.64, 0.71, 0.78) * val_span,
      label = c(
        "Validation:",
        sprintf("n = %d", nrow(val_data)),
        sprintf("R² = %.3f", val_r2),
        sprintf("r = %.3f", val_corr),
        sprintf("RMSE = %.3f", val_rmse)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 5.5,
      color = "#D55E00",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain")
    ) +
    
    # Thème magnifique avec polices plus grandes
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      # Titre
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
      
      # Titres et texte des axes (PLUS GRANDS)
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      
      # Supprimer la légende (nous avons des annotations)
      legend.position = "none",
      
      # Panneau
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 1.2),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      
      # Marges
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    )
  
  # Sauvegarder la figure haute résolution
  filename <- paste0(var_name, "_journal_FR.png")
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, filename), 
    p,
    width = 140,
    height = 140,
    units = "mm",
    dpi = 600,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  # Sauvegarder aussi la version PDF
  filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_journal_FR.pdf")
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, filename_pdf), 
    p,
    width = 140,
    height = 140,
    units = "mm",
    device = cairo_pdf,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✓ Entraîn.: n=", nrow(train_data), ", R²=", round(train_r2, 3), 
        ", RMSE=", round(train_rmse, 3), "\n")
    cat("  ✓ Valid.: n=", nrow(val_data), ", R²=", round(val_r2, 3), 
        ", RMSE=", round(val_rmse, 3), "\n")
  }
  
  return(list(
    variable = var_name,
    train_n = nrow(train_data),
    train_r2 = train_r2,
    train_rmse = train_rmse,
    train_corr = train_corr,
    val_n = nrow(val_data),
    val_r2 = val_r2,
    val_rmse = val_rmse,
    val_corr = val_corr
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# ÉTAPE 5: TRAITER TOUTES LES VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 CRÉATION DES GRAPHIQUES DE STYLE JOURNAL:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 42), "\n", sep="")

results_summary <- list()
plot_counter <- 0

# ============================================================================
# GROUPE 1: GRANULOMÉTRIE (5)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n[GROUPE 1: GRANULOMÉTRIE - 5 VARIABLES]\n")
for (i in seq_along(GRANULO_VARS)) {
  var_name <- GRANULO_VARS[i]
  var_label <- GRANULO_LABELS_FR[i]
  plot_counter <- plot_counter + 1
  cat(sprintf("[%2d] ", plot_counter))
  
  result <- create_journal_combined_plot_fr(var_name, var_label, parcelles_all, 
                                             is_enhanced = FALSE, verbose = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    results_summary[[var_name]] <- result
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# GROUPE 2: ÉLÉMENTS ÉCHANGEABLES (4)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n[GROUPE 2: ÉLÉMENTS ÉCHANGEABLES - 4 VARIABLES]\n")
for (i in seq_along(EXCHANGEABLE_VARS)) {
  var_name <- EXCHANGEABLE_VARS[i]
  var_label <- EXCHANGEABLE_LABELS_FR[i]
  source_type <- EXCHANGEABLE_SOURCES[i]
  plot_counter <- plot_counter + 1
  cat(sprintf("[%2d] ", plot_counter))
  
  if (source_type == "original") {
    result <- create_journal_combined_plot_fr(var_name, var_label, parcelles_all,
                                               is_enhanced = FALSE, verbose = TRUE)
  } else {
    result <- create_journal_combined_plot_fr(var_name, var_label, parcelles_enhanced,
                                               is_enhanced = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    results_summary[[var_name]] <- result
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# GROUPE 3: AUTRES PROPRIÉTÉS (8)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n[GROUPE 3: AUTRES PROPRIÉTÉS - 8 VARIABLES]\n")
for (i in seq_along(OTHER_VARS)) {
  var_name <- OTHER_VARS[i]
  var_label <- OTHER_LABELS_FR[i]
  source_type <- OTHER_SOURCES[i]
  plot_counter <- plot_counter + 1
  cat(sprintf("[%2d] ", plot_counter))
  
  if (source_type == "original") {
    result <- create_journal_combined_plot_fr(var_name, var_label, parcelles_all,
                                               is_enhanced = FALSE, verbose = TRUE)
  } else {
    result <- create_journal_combined_plot_fr(var_name, var_label, parcelles_enhanced,
                                               is_enhanced = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    results_summary[[var_name]] <- result
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# ÉTAPE 6: CRÉER LA TABLE RÉCAPITULATIVE
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 CRÉATION DE LA TABLE RÉCAPITULATIVE:\n")

summary_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(results_summary), function(var) {
  res <- results_summary[[var]]
  data.frame(
    Variable = var,
    N_Entraîn = res$train_n,
    R2_Entraîn = round(res$train_r2, 3),
    RMSE_Entraîn = round(res$train_rmse, 3),
    Corr_Entraîn = round(res$train_corr, 3),
    N_Valid = res$val_n,
    R2_Valid = round(res$val_r2, 3),
    RMSE_Valid = round(res$val_rmse, 3),
    Corr_Valid = round(res$val_corr, 3),
    Delta_R2 = round(res$train_r2 - res$val_r2, 3),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

write_csv(summary_df, file.path(output_dir, "journal_plots_summary_FR.csv"))
```

```{r}
OTHER_LABELS_FR <- c("pH", "C organique", "N total", "P₂O₅ disp.", "CE", "Rapport Mg/Ca", "Rapport Mg/K", "Indice compact.")

  "Coarse_Silt_percent",
  "Fine_Sand_percent",
  "Coarse_Sand_percent"
)

create_ilr_basis <- function(D) {
  V <- matrix(0, nrow = D - 1, ncol = D)
  for (i in 1:(D - 1)) {
    V[i, 1:i] <- 1/i
    V[i, i + 1] <- -1
    V[i, ] <- V[i, ] * sqrt(i / (i + 1))
  }
  return(V)
}

ilr_transform <- function(composition_matrix) {
  D <- ncol(composition_matrix)
  V <- create_ilr_basis(D)
  log_comp <- log(composition_matrix)
  ilr_coords <- log_comp %*% t(V)
  return(ilr_coords)
}

# ============================================================================
# ÉTAPE 5: FONCTION DE GRAPHIQUE AVEC ÉTIQUETTE EN HAUT À GAUCHE
# ============================================================================

create_labeled_plot <- function(var_name, var_label, data_sf, letter_label, 
                                 language = "EN", is_enhanced = FALSE, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ", letter_label, ".", var_name, "\n")
  }
  
  # Noms des colonnes
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Pour les variables améliorées
  if (is_enhanced) {
    possible_original_names <- c(var_name, gsub("_", "", var_name), paste0(var_name, "_original"))
    original_col <- NULL
    for (name in possible_original_names) {
      if (name %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
        original_col <- name
        break
      }
    }
    if (is.null(original_col)) return(NULL)
  } else {
    original_col <- var_name
  }
  
  # Vérifier les colonnes
  if (!pred_col %in% colnames(data_sf) || !pred_type_col %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extraire les données
  if (language == "EN") {
    plot_data <- data_sf %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[original_col]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
      mutate(
        Observed = .data[[original_col]],
        Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
        Dataset = factor(
          case_when(
            .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Training",
            .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
            TRUE ~ "Other"
          ),
          levels = c("Training", "Validation")
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  } else {
    plot_data <- data_sf %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[original_col]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
      mutate(
        Observed = .data[[original_col]],
        Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
        Dataset = factor(
          case_when(
            .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Entraînement",
            .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
            TRUE ~ "Autre"
          ),
          levels = c("Entraînement", "Validation")
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  }
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == ifelse(language == "EN", "Training", "Entraînement"))
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  # Métriques
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  train_corr <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)
  val_corr <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_data$Observed - train_data$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_data$Observed - val_data$Predicted)^2))
  
  # Limites des axes
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Étiquettes selon la langue
  if (language == "EN") {
    x_label <- "Observed"
    y_label <- "Predicted"
    train_label <- "Training:"
    val_label <- "Validation:"
  } else {
    x_label <- "Observé"
    y_label <- "Prédit"
    train_label <- "Entraînement:"
    val_label <- "Validation:"
  }
  
  # Créer le graphique de base avec tag pour la lettre
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 3, alpha = 0.75, stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"), name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00"), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17), name = NULL) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label, title = var_label, tag = paste0("(", letter_label, ")")) +
    annotate("text", x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
             y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.05, 0.12, 0.19, 0.26, 0.33, 0.40) * val_span,
             label = c(train_label, sprintf("n = %d", nrow(train_data)),
                      sprintf("R² = %.3f", train_r2), sprintf("r = %.3f", train_corr),
                      sprintf("RMSE = %.3f", train_rmse), ""),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 5.5, color = "#0072B2",
             fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain")) +
    annotate("text", x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
             y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.47, 0.54, 0.61, 0.68, 0.75) * val_span,
             label = c(val_label, sprintf("n = %d", nrow(val_data)),
                      sprintf("R² = %.3f", val_r2), sprintf("r = %.3f", val_corr),
                      sprintf("RMSE = %.3f", val_rmse)),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 5.5, color = "#D55E00",
             fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.99),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 1.2),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Fonction pour les ILR
create_ilr_labeled_plot <- function(ilr_index, data_sf, letter_label, language = "EN", verbose = TRUE) {
  
  ilr_var <- paste0("ILR_", ilr_index)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ", letter_label, ". ILR", ilr_index, "\n")
  }
  
  comp_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(Clay_percent), !is.na(Fine_Silt_percent), !is.na(Coarse_Silt_percent),
           !is.na(Fine_Sand_percent), !is.na(Coarse_Sand_percent)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ILR_1_predicted))
  
  if (nrow(comp_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  if ("Clay_percent_prediction_type" %in% colnames(comp_data)) {
    if (language == "FR") {
      comp_data <- comp_data %>%
        mutate(Dataset = factor(case_when(
          Clay_percent_prediction_type == "train" ~ "Entraînement",
          Clay_percent_prediction_type == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ), levels = c("Entraînement", "Validation")))
    } else {
      comp_data <- comp_data %>%
        mutate(Dataset = factor(case_when(
          Clay_percent_prediction_type == "train" ~ "Training",
          Clay_percent_prediction_type == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ), levels = c("Training", "Validation")))
    }
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  comp_data <- comp_data %>% filter(!is.na(Dataset))
  train_data <- comp_data %>% filter(Dataset == ifelse(language == "FR", "Entraînement", "Training"))
  val_data <- comp_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  # Calculer ILR observés
  train_comp <- train_data %>% dplyr::select(all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) %>% as.matrix()
  train_comp[train_comp <= 0] <- 0.01
  train_comp <- train_comp / rowSums(train_comp) * 100
  train_ilr <- ilr_transform(train_comp / 100)
  
  val_comp <- val_data %>% dplyr::select(all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) %>% as.matrix()
  val_comp[val_comp <= 0] <- 0.01
  val_comp <- val_comp / rowSums(val_comp) * 100
  val_ilr <- ilr_transform(val_comp / 100)
  
  pred_col <- paste0("ILR_", ilr_index, "_predicted")
  
  plot_data <- bind_rows(
    train_data %>% mutate(Observed = train_ilr[, ilr_index], Predicted = .data[[pred_col]]),
    val_data %>% mutate(Observed = val_ilr[, ilr_index], Predicted = .data[[pred_col]])
  ) %>% filter(is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  train_subset <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == ifelse(language == "FR", "Entraînement", "Training"))
  val_subset <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_subset$Observed, train_subset$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_subset$Observed, val_subset$Predicted)^2
  train_corr <- cor(train_subset$Observed, train_subset$Predicted)
  val_corr <- cor(val_subset$Observed, val_subset$Predicted)
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_subset$Observed - train_subset$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_subset$Observed - val_subset$Predicted)^2))
  
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  if (language == "FR") {
    x_label <- "Prédit"
    y_label <- "Observé"
    title_label <- paste0("ILR", ilr_index)
    train_label <- "Entraînement:"
    val_label <- "Validation:"
  } else {
    x_label <- "Predicted"
    y_label <- "Observed"
    title_label <- paste0("ILR", ilr_index)
    train_label <- "Training:"
    val_label <- "Validation:"
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Predicted, y = Observed, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 3, alpha = 0.75, stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"), name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00"), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17), name = NULL) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label, title = title_label, tag = paste0("(", letter_label, ")")) +
    annotate("text", x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
             y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.05, 0.12, 0.19, 0.26, 0.33, 0.40) * val_span,
             label = c(train_label, sprintf("n = %d", nrow(train_subset)),
                      sprintf("R² = %.3f", train_r2), sprintf("r = %.3f", train_corr),
                      sprintf("RMSE = %.3f", train_rmse), ""),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 5.5, color = "#0072B2",
             fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain")) +
    annotate("text", x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
             y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.47, 0.54, 0.61, 0.68, 0.75) * val_span,
             label = c(val_label, sprintf("n = %d", nrow(val_subset)),
                      sprintf("R² = %.3f", val_r2), sprintf("r = %.3f", val_corr),
                      sprintf("RMSE = %.3f", val_rmse)),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 5.5, color = "#D55E00",
             fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.99),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 1.2),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

## II.2. Summary extraction

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# EXTRACTION DES MÉTRIQUES - VERSION FRANÇAISE
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  EXTRACTION DES MÉTRIQUES - FR        \n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# CHARGEMENT DES DONNÉES
# ============================================================================
base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"
gpkg_all_vars <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_ALL_VARIABLES_enhanced_predictions.gpkg")
gpkg_enhanced <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_ENHANCED_TRANSFORMATIONS_predictions.gpkg")

parcelles_all <- st_read(gpkg_all_vars, quiet = TRUE)
parcelles_enhanced <- st_read(gpkg_enhanced, quiet = TRUE)

# ============================================================================
# DÉFINIR LES VARIABLES
# ============================================================================

# Groupe 1: Granulométrie
GRANULO_VARS <- c("Clay_percent", "Fine_Silt_percent", "Coarse_Silt_percent", 
                  "Fine_Sand_percent", "Coarse_Sand_percent")
GRANULO_LABELS_FR <- c("Argile (%)", "Limon fin (%)", "Limon grossier (%)", 
                       "Sable fin (%)", "Sable grossier (%)")

# Groupe 2: Éléments Échangeables
EXCHANGEABLE_VARS <- c("Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g", "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g", 
                       "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g", "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g")
EXCHANGEABLE_LABELS_FR <- c("Ca éch. (meq/100g)", "Mg éch. (meq/100g)", 
                            "K éch. (meq/100g)", "Na éch. (meq/100g)")
EXCHANGEABLE_SOURCES <- c("original", "original", "original", "enhanced")

# Groupe 3: Autres Propriétés
OTHER_VARS <- c("pH", "Organic_Carbon_per_mille", "Total_Nitrogen_per_mille",
                "Available_P2O5_mg_kg", "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm",
                "Mg_Ca_Ratio", "Mg_K_Ratio", "Compaction_Index")
OTHER_LABELS_FR <- c("pH", "C organique (‰)", "N total (‰)", "P₂O₅ disp. (mg/kg)",
                     "CE (mmho/cm)", "Rapport Mg/Ca", "Rapport Mg/K", "Indice compaction")
OTHER_SOURCES <- c("original", "original", "original", "enhanced", "enhanced",
                   "original", "original", "enhanced")

# ============================================================================
# FONCTION DE CALCUL DES MÉTRIQUES
# ============================================================================
calculate_metrics <- function(var_name, data_sf, source_type = "original") {
  
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Déterminer la colonne originale
  if (source_type == "enhanced") {
    possible_names <- c(var_name, gsub("_", "", var_name), paste0(var_name, "_original"))
    original_col <- NULL
    for (name in possible_names) {
      if (name %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
        original_col <- name
        break
      }
    }
    if (is.null(original_col)) return(NULL)
  } else {
    original_col <- var_name
  }
  
  # Vérifier les colonnes
  if (!all(c(original_col, pred_col, pred_type_col) %in% colnames(data_sf))) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Préparer les données
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[original_col]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[original_col]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = case_when(
        .data[[pred_type_col]] %in% c("Training", "train") ~ "Entraînement",
        .data[[pred_type_col]] %in% c("Validation", "validation") ~ "Validation",
        TRUE ~ "Autre"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(Dataset %in% c("Entraînement", "Validation"), 
           is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Calculer métriques par dataset
  metrics_list <- list()
  
  for (dataset_name in c("Entraînement", "Validation")) {
    data_subset <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == dataset_name)
    
    if (nrow(data_subset) >= 5) {
      r2 <- cor(data_subset$Observed, data_subset$Predicted)^2
      rmse <- sqrt(mean((data_subset$Observed - data_subset$Predicted)^2))
      mae <- mean(abs(data_subset$Observed - data_subset$Predicted))
      n <- nrow(data_subset)
      
      metrics_list[[dataset_name]] <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Dataset = dataset_name,
        R2 = round(r2, 3),
        RMSE = round(rmse, 3),
        MAE = round(mae, 3),
        N = n,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  
  if (length(metrics_list) > 0) {
    return(bind_rows(metrics_list))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# CALCULER TOUTES LES MÉTRIQUES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 CALCUL DES MÉTRIQUES...\n")

all_metrics <- list()

# Granulométrie
cat("\n[GRANULOMÉTRIE]\n")
for (i in seq_along(GRANULO_VARS)) {
  cat("  •", GRANULO_LABELS_FR[i], "\n")
  metrics <- calculate_metrics(GRANULO_VARS[i], parcelles_all, "original")
  if (!is.null(metrics)) {
    metrics$Groupe <- "Granulométrie"
    metrics$Label_FR <- GRANULO_LABELS_FR[i]
    all_metrics[[length(all_metrics) + 1]] <- metrics
  }
}

# Éléments Échangeables
cat("\n[ÉLÉMENTS ÉCHANGEABLES]\n")
for (i in seq_along(EXCHANGEABLE_VARS)) {
  cat("  •", EXCHANGEABLE_LABELS_FR[i], "\n")
  data_source <- if (EXCHANGEABLE_SOURCES[i] == "original") parcelles_all else parcelles_enhanced
  metrics <- calculate_metrics(EXCHANGEABLE_VARS[i], data_source, EXCHANGEABLE_SOURCES[i])
  if (!is.null(metrics)) {
    metrics$Groupe <- "Éléments échangeables"
    metrics$Label_FR <- EXCHANGEABLE_LABELS_FR[i]
    all_metrics[[length(all_metrics) + 1]] <- metrics
  }
}

# Autres Propriétés
cat("\n[AUTRES PROPRIÉTÉS]\n")
for (i in seq_along(OTHER_VARS)) {
  cat("  •", OTHER_LABELS_FR[i], "\n")
  data_source <- if (OTHER_SOURCES[i] == "original") parcelles_all else parcelles_enhanced
  metrics <- calculate_metrics(OTHER_VARS[i], data_source, OTHER_SOURCES[i])
  if (!is.null(metrics)) {
    metrics$Groupe <- "Autres propriétés"
    metrics$Label_FR <- OTHER_LABELS_FR[i]
    all_metrics[[length(all_metrics) + 1]] <- metrics
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# CRÉER LE TABLEAU FINAL
# ============================================================================
metrics_df <- bind_rows(all_metrics) %>%
  select(Groupe, Label_FR, Variable, Dataset, R2, RMSE, MAE, N)

# ============================================================================
# SAUVEGARDER
# ============================================================================
output_file <- paste0(base_path, "metriques_modeles_FR.csv")
write_csv(metrics_df, output_file)

cat("\n✅ TERMINÉ!\n")
cat("📁 Fichier sauvegardé:", output_file, "\n")
cat("📊 Total de lignes:", nrow(metrics_df), "\n")

# Afficher aperçu
cat("\n📋 APERÇU DES MÉTRIQUES:\n")
print(metrics_df, n = 20)
```

```{r}
# CHARGEMENT DES DONNÉES

base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"
gpkg_all_vars <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_ALL_VARIABLES_enhanced_predictions.gpkg")
gpkg_enhanced <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_ENHANCED_TRANSFORMATIONS_predictions.gpkg")

parcelles_all <- st_read(gpkg_all_vars, quiet = TRUE)
parcelles_enhanced <- st_read(gpkg_enhanced, quiet = TRUE)

# ============================================================================
# DÉFINIR LES VARIABLES
# ============================================================================

# Groupe 1: Granulométrie
GRANULO_VARS <- c("Clay_percent", "Fine_Silt_percent", "Coarse_Silt_percent", 
                  "Fine_Sand_percent", "Coarse_Sand_percent")
GRANULO_LABELS_FR <- c("Argile (%)", "Limon fin (%)", "Limon grossier (%)", 
                       "Sable fin (%)", "Sable grossier (%)")

# Groupe 2: Éléments Échangeables
EXCHANGEABLE_VARS <- c("Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g", "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g", 
                       "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g", "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g")
EXCHANGEABLE_LABELS_FR <- c("Ca éch. (meq/100g)", "Mg éch. (meq/100g)", 
                            "K éch. (meq/100g)", "Na éch. (meq/100g)")
EXCHANGEABLE_SOURCES <- c("original", "original", "original", "enhanced")

# Groupe 3: Autres Propriétés
OTHER_VARS <- c("pH", "Organic_Carbon_per_mille", "Total_Nitrogen_per_mille",
                "Available_P2O5_mg_kg", "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm",
                "Mg_Ca_Ratio", "Mg_K_Ratio", "Compaction_Index")
OTHER_LABELS_FR <- c("pH", "C organique (‰)", "N total (‰)", "P₂O₅ disp. (mg/kg)",
                     "CE (mmho/cm)", "Rapport Mg/Ca", "Rapport Mg/K", "Indice compaction")
OTHER_SOURCES <- c("original", "original", "original", "enhanced", "enhanced",
                   "original", "original", "enhanced")

# ============================================================================
# FONCTION DE CALCUL DES MÉTRIQUES (CORRIGÉE)
# ============================================================================
calculate_metrics <- function(var_name, data_sf, source_type = "original") {
  
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  imputed_col <- paste0(var_name, "_imputed")  # NOUVEAU: colonne d'imputation
  
  # Déterminer la colonne originale
  if (source_type == "enhanced") {
    possible_names <- c(var_name, gsub("_", "", var_name), paste0(var_name, "_original"))
    original_col <- NULL
    for (name in possible_names) {
      if (name %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
        original_col <- name
        break
      }
    }
    if (is.null(original_col)) return(NULL)
  } else {
    original_col <- var_name
  }
  
  # Vérifier les colonnes essentielles
  if (!all(c(original_col, pred_col, pred_type_col) %in% colnames(data_sf))) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Vérifier si la colonne d'imputation existe
  has_imputed_col <- imputed_col %in% colnames(data_sf)
  
  # Préparer les données
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[original_col]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[original_col]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = case_when(
        .data[[pred_type_col]] %in% c("Training", "train") ~ "Entraînement",
        .data[[pred_type_col]] %in% c("Validation", "validation") ~ "Validation",
        TRUE ~ "Autre"
      )
    )
  
  # NOUVEAU: Ajouter indicateur d'imputation si la colonne existe
  if (has_imputed_col) {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      mutate(Is_Imputed = .data[[imputed_col]] == TRUE | .data[[imputed_col]] == 1)
  } else {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      mutate(Is_Imputed = FALSE)
  }
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    filter(Dataset %in% c("Entraînement", "Validation"), 
           is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Calculer métriques par dataset
  metrics_list <- list()
  
  for (dataset_name in c("Entraînement", "Validation")) {
    data_subset <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == dataset_name)
    
    if (nrow(data_subset) >= 5) {
      # CORRECTION: Pour l'entraînement, exclure les valeurs imputées du comptage N
      if (dataset_name == "Entraînement") {
        n_real <- sum(!data_subset$Is_Imputed)  # Seulement les vraies observations
        n_total <- nrow(data_subset)
        n_imputed <- sum(data_subset$Is_Imputed)
      } else {
        n_real <- nrow(data_subset)
        n_total <- nrow(data_subset)
        n_imputed <- 0
      }
      
      # Calculer les métriques sur toutes les données (y compris imputées)
      r2 <- cor(data_subset$Observed, data_subset$Predicted)^2
      rmse <- sqrt(mean((data_subset$Observed - data_subset$Predicted)^2))
      mae <- mean(abs(data_subset$Observed - data_subset$Predicted))
      
      metrics_list[[dataset_name]] <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Dataset = dataset_name,
        R2 = round(r2, 3),
        RMSE = round(rmse, 3),
        MAE = round(mae, 3),
        N_Real = n_real,        # NOUVEAU: Nombre de vraies observations
        N_Imputed = n_imputed,  # NOUVEAU: Nombre d'imputées
        N_Total = n_total,      # NOUVEAU: Total
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  
  if (length(metrics_list) > 0) {
    return(bind_rows(metrics_list))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# FONCTION D'AFFICHAGE FORMATÉ (MISE À JOUR)
# ============================================================================
print_formatted_table <- function(df, title) {
  cat("\n")
  cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
  cat("  ", title, "\n")
  cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
  cat(sprintf("%-30s %-15s %8s %10s %10s %8s %10s %8s\n", 
              "Variable", "Dataset", "R²", "RMSE", "MAE", "N_Réel", "N_Imputé", "N_Total"))
  cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
    cat(sprintf("%-30s %-15s %8.3f %10.3f %10.3f %8d %10d %8d\n",
                df$Label_FR[i],
                df$Dataset[i],
                df$R2[i],
                df$RMSE[i],
                df$MAE[i],
                df$N_Real[i],
                df$N_Imputed[i],
                df$N_Total[i]))
  }
  
  cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# CALCULER TOUTES LES MÉTRIQUES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 CALCUL DES MÉTRIQUES EN COURS...\n")

all_metrics <- list()

# Granulométrie
for (i in seq_along(GRANULO_VARS)) {
  metrics <- calculate_metrics(GRANULO_VARS[i], parcelles_all, "original")
  if (!is.null(metrics)) {
    metrics$Groupe <- "Granulométrie"
    metrics$Label_FR <- GRANULO_LABELS_FR[i]
    all_metrics[[length(all_metrics) + 1]] <- metrics
  }
}

# Éléments Échangeables
for (i in seq_along(EXCHANGEABLE_VARS)) {
  data_source <- if (EXCHANGEABLE_SOURCES[i] == "original") parcelles_all else parcelles_enhanced
  metrics <- calculate_metrics(EXCHANGEABLE_VARS[i], data_source, EXCHANGEABLE_SOURCES[i])
  if (!is.null(metrics)) {
    metrics$Groupe <- "Éléments échangeables"
    metrics$Label_FR <- EXCHANGEABLE_LABELS_FR[i]
    all_metrics[[length(all_metrics) + 1]] <- metrics
  }
}

# Autres Propriétés
for (i in seq_along(OTHER_VARS)) {
  data_source <- if (OTHER_SOURCES[i] == "original") parcelles_all else parcelles_enhanced
  metrics <- calculate_metrics(OTHER_VARS[i], data_source, OTHER_SOURCES[i])
  if (!is.null(metrics)) {
    metrics$Groupe <- "Autres propriétés"
    metrics$Label_FR <- OTHER_LABELS_FR[i]
    all_metrics[[length(all_metrics) + 1]] <- metrics
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# CRÉER LE TABLEAU FINAL
# ============================================================================
metrics_df <- bind_rows(all_metrics) %>%
  select(Groupe, Label_FR, Variable, Dataset, R2, RMSE, MAE, N_Real, N_Imputed, N_Total)

# ============================================================================
# AFFICHER PAR GROUPE
# ============================================================================

# Groupe 1: Granulométrie
granulo_df <- metrics_df %>% filter(Groupe == "Granulométrie")
print_formatted_table(granulo_df, "GROUPE 1: GRANULOMÉTRIE")

# Groupe 2: Éléments Échangeables
exchange_df <- metrics_df %>% filter(Groupe == "Éléments échangeables")
print_formatted_table(exchange_df, "GROUPE 2: ÉLÉMENTS ÉCHANGEABLES")

# Groupe 3: Autres Propriétés
other_df <- metrics_df %>% filter(Groupe == "Autres propriétés")
print_formatted_table(other_df, "GROUPE 3: AUTRES PROPRIÉTÉS DU SOL")



summary_stats <- metrics_df %>%
  group_by(Dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Variables = n_distinct(Variable),
    N_Real_Total = sum(N_Real),
    N_Imputed_Total = sum(N_Imputed),
    N_Total_Total = sum(N_Total),
    R2_Moyen = mean(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    R2_Min = min(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    R2_Max = max(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSE_Moyen = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAE_Moyen = mean(MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

cat(sprintf("%-15s %10s %10s %12s %10s %10s %10s %10s %12s %12s\n",
            "Dataset", "N_Vars", "N_Réel", "N_Imputé", "N_Total", 
            "R²_Moy", "R²_Min", "R²_Max", "RMSE_Moy", "MAE_Moy"))


for (i in 1:nrow(summary_stats)) {
  cat(sprintf("%-15s %10d %10d %12d %10d %10.3f %10.3f %10.3f %12.3f %12.3f\n",
              summary_stats$Dataset[i],
              summary_stats$N_Variables[i],
              summary_stats$N_Real_Total[i],
              summary_stats$N_Imputed_Total[i],
              summary_stats$N_Total_Total[i],
              summary_stats$R2_Moyen[i],
              summary_stats$R2_Min[i],
              summary_stats$R2_Max[i],
              summary_stats$RMSE_Moyen[i],
              summary_stats$MAE_Moyen[i]))
}




imputation_stats <- metrics_df %>%
  filter(Dataset == "Entraînement", N_Imputed > 0) %>%
  mutate(Pct_Imputed = round(100 * N_Imputed / N_Total, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Pct_Imputed)) %>%
  select(Groupe, Label_FR, N_Real, N_Imputed, N_Total, Pct_Imputed)

if (nrow(imputation_stats) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("%-25s %-30s %10s %12s %10s %12s\n",
              "Groupe", "Variable", "N_Réel", "N_Imputé", "N_Total", "% Imputé"))

  
  for (i in 1:nrow(imputation_stats)) {
    cat(sprintf("%-25s %-30s %10d %12d %10d %11.1f%%\n",
                imputation_stats$Groupe[i],
                imputation_stats$Label_FR[i],
                imputation_stats$N_Real[i],
                imputation_stats$N_Imputed[i],
                imputation_stats$N_Total[i],
                imputation_stats$Pct_Imputed[i]))
  }
} else {
  cat("Aucune valeur imputée détectée.\n")
}



# ============================================================================
# SAUVEGARDER EN CSV
# ============================================================================
output_file <- paste0(base_path, "metriques_modeles_FR_corrigees.csv")
write_csv(metrics_df, output_file)

cat("\n✅ TERMINÉ!\n")
cat("📁 Fichier CSV sauvegardé:", output_file, "\n")
cat("📊 Total de lignes:", nrow(metrics_df), "\n")
cat("📊 Variables analysées:", n_distinct(metrics_df$Variable), "\n")
cat("📊 Observations réelles (entraînement):", sum(metrics_df$N_Real[metrics_df$Dataset == "Entraînement"]), "\n")
cat("📊 Observations imputées (entraînement):", sum(metrics_df$N_Imputed[metrics_df$Dataset == "Entraînement"]), "\n\n")
```
