create_journal_plot_object_fr <- function(var_name, var_label, data_sf, letter_label = NULL, 
                                          save_individual = TRUE, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      cat("📊 ", letter_label, ". ", var_name, "\n", sep = "")
    } else {
      cat("📊", var_name, "\n")
    }
  }
  
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  if (!pred_col %in% colnames(data_sf) || !pred_type_col %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
    if (verbose) {
      cat("  ⚠️ Ignoré - colonnes introuvables\n")
    }
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[var_name]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Entraînement",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Autre"
        ),
        levels = c("Entraînement", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Pas de données valides\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Entraînement")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Données insuffisantes\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_data$Observed - train_data$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_data$Observed - val_data$Predicted)^2))
  
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = "Observé",
      y = "Prédit",
      title = var_label,
      tag = paste0(letter_label, ".")
    )
  } else {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = "Observé",
      y = "Prédit",
      title = var_label
    )
  }
  
  # Split data for layering (validation in foreground)
  train_plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Entraînement")
  val_plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    # Regression lines with confidence intervals
    geom_smooth(data = train_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, fill = Dataset),
                method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.0) +
    geom_smooth(data = val_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, fill = Dataset),
                method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.0) +
    # Plot training points FIRST (background - arrière plan)
    geom_point(data = train_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, shape = Dataset),
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0.3) +
    # Plot validation points SECOND (foreground - premier plan)
    geom_point(data = val_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, shape = Dataset),
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85, stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs_list +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.08, 0.16, 0.24) * val_span,  # Increased spacing
      label = c(
        sprintf("Entr.: R²=%.2f", train_r2),
        sprintf("Valid.: R²=%.2f", val_r2),
        sprintf("RMSE: %.2f/%.2f", train_rmse, val_rmse)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.5,
      color = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "black"),
      fontface = c("bold", "bold", "plain"),
      lineheight = 1.2  # Added line height for better spacing
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 3)),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, color = "grey20"),
      plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.99),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
      axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.8),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
    )
  
  if (save_individual) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_nature.png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_nature.pdf")
    } else {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_nature.png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_nature.pdf")
    }
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_png),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      dpi = 600,
      bg = "white"
    )
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_pdf),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      device = cairo_pdf,
      bg = "white"
    )
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✓ Entr.: R²=", round(train_r2, 3), ", Valid.: R²=", round(val_r2, 3), "\n")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

create_journal_plot_object_enhanced_fr <- function(var_name, var_label, data_sf, letter_label = NULL,
                                                     save_individual = TRUE, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      cat("📊 ", letter_label, ". ", var_name, " (amélioré)\n", sep = "")
    } else {
      cat("📊", var_name, "(amélioré)\n")
    }
  }
  
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  possible_original_names <- c(
    var_name,
    gsub("_", "", var_name),
    paste0(var_name, "_original")
  )
  
  original_col <- NULL
  for (name in possible_original_names) {
    if (name %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
      original_col <- name
      break
    }
  }
  
  if (is.null(original_col)) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Colonne originale introuvable\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  required_cols <- c(original_col, pred_col, pred_type_col)
  missing_cols <- required_cols[!required_cols %in% colnames(data_sf)]
  
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Colonnes manquantes:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[original_col]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[original_col]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Entraînement",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Autre"
        ),
        levels = c("Entraînement", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Pas de données valides\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Entraînement")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Données insuffisantes\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_data$Observed - train_data$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_data$Observed - val_data$Predicted)^2))
  
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = "Observé",
      y = "Prédit",
      title = var_label,
      tag = paste0(letter_label, ".")
    )
  } else {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = "Observé",
      y = "Prédit",
      title = var_label
    )
  }
  
  # Split data for layering (validation in foreground)
  train_plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Entraînement")
  val_plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    # Regression lines with confidence intervals
    geom_smooth(data = train_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, fill = Dataset),
                method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.0) +
    geom_smooth(data = val_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, fill = Dataset),
                method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.0) +
    # Plot training points FIRST (background - arrière plan)
    geom_point(data = train_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, shape = Dataset),
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0.3) +
    # Plot validation points SECOND (foreground - premier plan)
    geom_point(data = val_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, shape = Dataset),
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85, stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Entraînement" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs_list +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.08, 0.16, 0.24) * val_span,  # Increased spacing
      label = c(
        sprintf("Entr.: R²=%.2f", train_r2),
        sprintf("Valid.: R²=%.2f", val_r2),
        sprintf("RMSE: %.2f/%.2f", train_rmse, val_rmse)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.5,
      color = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "black"),
      fontface = c("bold", "bold", "plain"),
      lineheight = 1.2  # Added line height for better spacing
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 3)),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, color = "grey20"),
      plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.99),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
      axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.8),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
    )
  
  if (save_individual) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_enhanced_nature.png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_enhanced_nature.pdf")
    } else {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_enhanced_nature.png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_enhanced_nature.pdf")
    }
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_png),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      dpi = 600,
      bg = "white"
    )
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_pdf),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      device = cairo_pdf,
      bg = "white"
    )
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✓ Entr.: R²=", round(train_r2, 3), ", Valid.: R²=", round(val_r2, 3), "\n")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

cat("\n🔄 CRÉATION DES OBJETS GRAPHIQUES:\n")

library(sf)

create_journal_plot_object_fr <- function(var_name, var_label, data_sf, letter_label = NULL, 
                                          save_individual = TRUE, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      cat("📊 ", letter_label, ". ", var_name, "\n", sep = "")
    } else {
      cat("📊", var_name, "\n")
    }
  }
  
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  if (!pred_col %in% colnames(data_sf) || !pred_type_col %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
    if (verbose) {
      cat("  ⚠️ Skipped - columns not found\n")
    }
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[var_name]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Training",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        ),
        levels = c("Training", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ No valid data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Insufficient data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_data$Observed - train_data$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_data$Observed - val_data$Predicted)^2))
  
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = "Observed",
      y = "Predicted",
      title = var_label,
      tag = paste0(letter_label, ".")
    )
  } else {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = "Observed",
      y = "Predicted",
      title = var_label
    )
  }
  
  # Split data for layering (validation in foreground)
  train_plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    # Regression lines with confidence intervals
    geom_smooth(data = train_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, fill = Dataset),
                method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.0) +
    geom_smooth(data = val_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, fill = Dataset),
                method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.0) +
    # Plot training points FIRST (background)
    geom_point(data = train_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, shape = Dataset),
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0.3) +
    # Plot validation points SECOND (foreground)
    geom_point(data = val_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, shape = Dataset),
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85, stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Training" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs_list +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.08, 0.16, 0.24) * val_span,  # Increased spacing
      label = c(
        sprintf("Train: R²=%.2f", train_r2),
        sprintf("Valid.: R²=%.2f", val_r2),
        sprintf("RMSE: %.2f/%.2f", train_rmse, val_rmse)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.5,
      color = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "black"),
      fontface = c("bold", "bold", "plain"),
      lineheight = 1.2  # Added line height for better spacing
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 3)),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, color = "grey20"),
      plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.99),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
      axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.8),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
    )
  
  if (save_individual) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_nature.png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_nature.pdf")
    } else {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_nature.png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_nature.pdf")
    }
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_png),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      dpi = 600,
      bg = "white"
    )
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_pdf),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      device = cairo_pdf,
      bg = "white"
    )
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✓ Entr.: R²=", round(train_r2, 3), ", Valid.: R²=", round(val_r2, 3), "\n")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

create_journal_plot_object_enhanced_fr <- function(var_name, var_label, data_sf, letter_label = NULL,
                                                     save_individual = TRUE, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      cat("📊 ", letter_label, ". ", var_name, " (amélioré)\n", sep = "")
    } else {
      cat("📊", var_name, "(amélioré)\n")
    }
  }
  
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  possible_original_names <- c(
    var_name,
    gsub("_", "", var_name),
    paste0(var_name, "_original")
  )
  
  original_col <- NULL
  for (name in possible_original_names) {
    if (name %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
      original_col <- name
      break
    }
  }
  
  if (is.null(original_col)) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Original column not found\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  required_cols <- c(original_col, pred_col, pred_type_col)
  missing_cols <- required_cols[!required_cols %in% colnames(data_sf)]
  
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Missing columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[original_col]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[original_col]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Training",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        ),
        levels = c("Training", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ No valid data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Insufficient data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_data$Observed - train_data$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_data$Observed - val_data$Predicted)^2))
  
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = "Observed",
      y = "Predicted",
      title = var_label,
      tag = paste0(letter_label, ".")
    )
  } else {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = "Observed",
      y = "Predicted",
      title = var_label
    )
  }
  
  # Split data for layering (validation in foreground)
  train_plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    # Regression lines with confidence intervals
    geom_smooth(data = train_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, fill = Dataset),
                method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.0) +
    geom_smooth(data = val_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, fill = Dataset),
                method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.0) +
    # Plot training points FIRST (background)
    geom_point(data = train_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, shape = Dataset),
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0.3) +
    # Plot validation points SECOND (foreground)
    geom_point(data = val_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, shape = Dataset),
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85, stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Training" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs_list +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.08, 0.16, 0.24) * val_span,  # Increased spacing
      label = c(
        sprintf("Train: R²=%.2f", train_r2),
        sprintf("Valid.: R²=%.2f", val_r2),
        sprintf("RMSE: %.2f/%.2f", train_rmse, val_rmse)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.5,
      color = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "black"),
      fontface = c("bold", "bold", "plain"),
      lineheight = 1.2  # Added line height for better spacing
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 3)),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, color = "grey20"),
      plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.99),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
      axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.8),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
    )
  
  if (save_individual) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_enhanced_nature.png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_enhanced_nature.pdf")
    } else {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_enhanced_nature.png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_enhanced_nature.pdf")
    }
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_png),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      dpi = 600,
      bg = "white"
    )
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_pdf),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      device = cairo_pdf,
      bg = "white"
    )
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✓ Entr.: R²=", round(train_r2, 3), ", Valid.: R²=", round(val_r2, 3), "\n")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# ============================================================================
# PLOTTING FUNCTION - VALIDATION IN FOREGROUND
# ============================================================================

create_journal_plot_6grid <- function(var_name, var_label, data_sf, source_type = "original",
                                      letter_label = NULL, save_individual = TRUE, 
                                      lang = "en", verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      cat("📊 ", letter_label, ". ", var_name, " (", lang, ")\n", sep = "")
    } else {
      cat("📊", var_name, "(", lang, ")\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
  
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  # For enhanced variables, need to find the original column
  if (source_type == "enhanced") {
    possible_original_names <- c(
      var_name,
      gsub("_", "", var_name),
      paste0(var_name, "_original")
    )
    
    original_col <- NULL
    for (name in possible_original_names) {
      if (name %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
        original_col <- name
        break
      }
    }
    
    if (is.null(original_col)) {
      if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Colonne originale introuvable\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  } else {
    original_col <- var_name
  }
  
  required_cols <- c(original_col, pred_col, pred_type_col)
  missing_cols <- required_cols[!required_cols %in% colnames(data_sf)]
  
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Colonnes manquantes:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Set dataset labels based on language
  if (lang == "en") {
    train_label <- "Training"
    val_label <- "Validation"
  } else {
    train_label <- "Entraînement"
    val_label <- "Validation"
  }
  
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[original_col]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[original_col]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ train_label,
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ val_label,
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        ),
        levels = c(train_label, val_label)
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Pas de données valides\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Split data for statistics
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == train_label)
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == val_label)
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Données insuffisantes\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_data$Observed - train_data$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_data$Observed - val_data$Predicted)^2))
  
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Set axis labels based on language
  if (lang == "en") {
    x_label <- "Observed"
    y_label <- "Predicted"
  } else {
    x_label <- "Observé"
    y_label <- "Prédit"
  }
  
  # Create label list
  if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label,
      title = var_label,
      tag = paste0(letter_label, ".")
    )
  } else {
    labs_list <- labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label,
      title = var_label
    )
  }
  
  # CRITICAL: Plot training first, then validation on top (foreground)
  # This is achieved by arranging the data with training first, validation second
  # and using geom_point twice instead of relying on factor ordering
  
  train_plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == train_label)
  val_plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == val_label)
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    # Regression lines with shaded confidence intervals
    geom_smooth(data = train_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, fill = Dataset), 
                method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.0) +
    geom_smooth(data = val_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, fill = Dataset), 
                method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.0) +
    # Plot training points first (background)
    geom_point(data = train_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, shape = Dataset), 
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0.3) +
    # Plot validation points second (foreground) - higher alpha for emphasis
    geom_point(data = val_plot_data, aes(color = Dataset, shape = Dataset), 
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85, stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(16, 17),  # Circle for training, triangle for validation
      name = NULL
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs_list +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.08, 0.16, 0.24) * val_span,  # Increased spacing from 0.15 to 0.16, 0.22 to 0.24
      label = c(
        sprintf(ifelse(lang == "en", "Train: R²=%.2f", "Entr.: R²=%.2f"), train_r2),
        sprintf(ifelse(lang == "en", "Valid.: R²=%.2f", "Valid.: R²=%.2f"), val_r2),
        sprintf("RMSE: %.2f/%.2f", train_rmse, val_rmse)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.5,
      color = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "black"),
      fontface = c("bold", "bold", "plain"),
      lineheight = 1.2  # Add line height parameter for better spacing
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 3)),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, color = "grey20"),
      plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.99),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
      axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.8),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
    )
  
  if (save_individual) {
    if (!is.null(letter_label)) {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_", lang, ".png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_", letter_label, "_", lang, ".pdf")
    } else {
      filename_png <- paste0(var_name, "_", lang, ".png")
      filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_", lang, ".pdf")
    }
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_png),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      dpi = 600,
      bg = "white"
    )
    
    ggsave(
      file.path(output_dir_individual, filename_pdf),
      p,
      width = 120,
      height = 120,
      units = "mm",
      device = cairo_pdf,
      bg = "white"
    )
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✓ Train: R²=", round(train_r2, 3), ", Valid.: R²=", round(val_r2, 3), "\n")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# ============================================================================
# MAIN EXECUTION - GENERATE ALL VERSIONS
# ============================================================================

generate_6plot_grid <- function(lang = "en", layout = "2x3") {
  
  cat("\n", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("GENERATING ", toupper(lang), " VERSION - LAYOUT: ", layout, "\n", sep = "")
  cat(rep("=", 60), "\n\n", sep = "")
  
  plot_list <- list()
  letters_lower <- letters
  
  # Select appropriate labels
  labels_list <- if (lang == "en") SELECTED_LABELS_EN else SELECTED_LABELS_FR
  
  # Create all 6 plots
  for (i in seq_along(SELECTED_VARS)) {
    var_name <- SELECTED_VARS[i]
    var_label <- labels_list[[i]]
    source_type <- SELECTED_SOURCES[i]
    letter <- letters_lower[i]
    
    cat(sprintf("[%d] ", i))
    
    # Select appropriate dataset
    data_to_use <- if (source_type == "enhanced") parcelles_enhanced else parcelles_all
    
    p <- create_journal_plot_6grid(
      var_name, 
      var_label, 
      data_to_use,
      source_type = source_type,
      letter_label = letter,
      save_individual = TRUE,
      lang = lang,
      verbose = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!is.null(p)) {
      plot_list[[var_name]] <- p
    }
  }
  
  if (length(plot_list) != 6) {
    cat("\n⚠️ WARNING: Only", length(plot_list), "plots created instead of 6!\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n✅ Total plots created:", length(plot_list), "\n")
  
  # Determine layout dimensions
  if (layout == "2x3") {
    n_rows <- 2
    n_cols <- 3
    layout_suffix <- "2rows_3cols"
  } else {  # 3x2
    n_rows <- 3
    n_cols <- 2
    layout_suffix <- "3rows_2cols"
  }
  
  cat("\n🎨 COMBINING PLOTS IN GRID:\n")
  cat("  Dimensions:", n_rows, "×", n_cols, "\n")
  
  # Create combined plot
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = n_cols, nrow = n_rows) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "",
      subtitle = "",
      caption = "",
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey50")
      )
    ) &
    theme(plot.margin = margin(3, 8, 3, 3))
  
  cat("\n💾 SAVING COMBINED GRID:\n")
  
  # Calculate dimensions
  subplot_width_mm <- 90
  subplot_height_mm <- 85
  margin_mm <- 15
  
  total_width_mm <- n_cols * subplot_width_mm + margin_mm
  total_height_mm <- n_rows * subplot_height_mm + margin_mm
  
  cat("  Dimensions:", total_width_mm, "×", total_height_mm, "mm\n")
  
  # Save files
  filename_png <- paste0("grid_6plots_", lang, "_", layout_suffix, ".png")
  filename_pdf <- paste0("grid_6plots_", lang, "_", layout_suffix, ".pdf")
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir_combined, filename_png),
    combined_plot,
    width = total_width_mm,
    height = total_height_mm,
    units = "mm",
    dpi = 600,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir_combined, filename_pdf),
    combined_plot,
    width = total_width_mm,
    height = total_height_mm,
    units = "mm",
    device = cairo_pdf,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  cat("  ✓ Saved:", filename_png, "\n")
  cat("  ✓ Saved:", filename_pdf, "\n")
  
  return(combined_plot)
}


# Version 1: English, 2x3
plot_en_2x3 <- generate_6plot_grid(lang = "en", layout = "2x3")

# Version 2: English, 3x2
plot_en_3x2 <- generate_6plot_grid(lang = "en", layout = "3x2")

# Version 3: French, 2x3
plot_fr_2x3 <- generate_6plot_grid(lang = "fr", layout = "2x3")

# Version 4: French, 3x2
plot_fr_3x2 <- generate_6plot_grid(lang = "fr", layout = "3x2")
